title: Tum ek 100 WATT ka bulb ho
description: Season 2 Episode 15: Power is energy per second; a "unit" on your electricity bill is energy (1 kWh = 3.6 million joules), not power.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 5 (power P = W/t, watt, kilowatt-hour)
exam_focus: Boards: "1 unit = 1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J" — guaranteed question
hook_text: Tum = 100 W bulb 💡 (aur bijli ka 'unit' kya hai?)
concept: Power is energy per second; a "unit" on your electricity bill is energy (1 kWh = 3.6 million joules), not power.
on_screen_cues: "P = E / t · 1 W = 1 J/s" → "Human at rest ≈ 100 W" → "1 unit = 1 kWh = 1000 W × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10⁶ J" → "NCERT XI Ch 5"
pinned_comment: Tumhare ghar ka AC 1.5 kW ka hai, 8 ghante chala. Kitne units? Pehle 10 sahi answers ko ❤️
suggested_titles: "Tum ek 100 watt ka bulb ho 💡" / "Bijli ka 'unit' kya hota hai? 99% log galat samajhte hain"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, main 100 watt ka bulb kaise hoon?!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Tumhara body baithe baithe har second 100 joule energy kharch karta hai. 100 joule per second matlab 100 WATT!
Gudiya: [surprised] Bulb jitna?!
Chintu: [excited] Haan! Ek room mein 50 log matlab 5000 watt ka heater. Isliye bhare hall garam ho jaate hain!
Gudiya: [laughs] Toh power matlab energy kitni TEZI se kharch ho rahi hai?
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Power is not energy. Power is energy PER SECOND.
Gudiya: [confused] Toh bijli ka bill "units" mein kyun aata hai? Unit kya hai?
Chintu: [mischievously] Yeh sabse bada confusion hai. Ek unit matlab ek KILO-watt hour.
Gudiya: [curious] Woh power hai ya energy?
Chintu: [excited] ENERGY! 1000 watt ka heater 1 ghanta chale... 1 unit. 36 lakh joule!
Gudiya: [gasps] 36 lakh joule?!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Aur tumhara body ek din mein 2 unit se zyada kharch karta hai. Tum ek chhota heater ho!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Matlab watt speed hai, joule maal hai... aur unit bas bade joule ka naam!
Chintu: [proudly] Yeh line board exam mein 3 marks ki hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Par energy toh kabhi khatam nahi hoti na? Toh "energy bachao" kyun bolte hain?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
